title: FizzBuzz Feedback Loop
description: Return the FizzBuzz sequence from 1 to n as a list-like collection of strings.
prompt: Write a function that returns the sequence from 1 to n. Multiples of 3 become Fizz, multiples of 5 become Buzz, and multiples of both become FizzBuzz.

starterCode.ruby:
def fizzbuzz(n)
  result = []
  (1..n).each do |value|
    result << value.to_s
  end
  result
end
